desc: Ideation complete: identify the problem as a GF(2) constraint system reducible to row/column bits and parity DSU.
Implement complete Python solution reading all test cases efficiently under sum(HW) <= 1e6.
Compute row and column parities of A tiles and immediately output 0 if any row or column parity is odd.
Derive and implement the exact XOR right-hand side for each B cell from row/column prefix parities, carefully handling wrap-around and edge conventions.
Implement a parity-weighted DSU over H+W vertices supporting union with required XOR value and contradiction detection.
Process every B cell as a parity constraint between its row vertex and column vertex.
If no contradiction exists, count connected components among all H+W row/column vertices, including isolated vertices, and output 2^components modulo 998244353.
Validate on the provided samples and edge cases such as all A, all B, no B, inconsistent cycles, and very skinny grids.
